[Act: motor-vehicles
 Chapter: Offences, Penalties and Procedure
 Section: 189::Racing and trials of speed.
]


Whoever without the written consent of the State Government permits or takes part in a race or trial of speed of any kind between motor vehicles in any public place shall be punishable with imprisonment for a term which may extend to 3[three months], or with fine 4[of five thousand rupees], or with both 5[and for a subsequent offence shall be punishable with imprisonment for a term which may extend to one year, or with fine of ten thousand rupees; or with both].
